_comment: NEEDS_NEW_DSL for 'target attack action card with Herald in its NAME' — no name-matching target filter exists. Also dropped a bogus DESTROY_PERMANENT self cost: this is an Instant, not a permanent, so it is played, not destroyed. The +2 angel clause is implemented. ability_type is PLAY, not INSTANT: in this DSL INSTANT means an ACTIVATED ability with instant timing ('Instant - Destroy this: ...') and maps to ON_ACTIVATE, whereas an Instant CARD resolves when played.
